name: guardrail
description: Blocks hook-skipping git commands and live data operations that have no successful dry run first; you can allow one at a time

blockNoVerify.title: Block hook skipping
blockNoVerify.description: Deny git --no-verify, core.hooksPath overrides and HUSKY/SKIP env tricks

blockLiveWithoutDryRun.title: Block live data operations without a dry run
blockLiveWithoutDryRun.description: Deny sqlpackage publish, migrations, data scripts and --live commands until a dry run succeeded

dryRunScope.title: Dry-run scope
dryRunScope.description: tool: a dry run unlocks the same tool and target. session: any successful dry run unlocks every live operation

extraLivePattern.title: Extra live pattern
extraLivePattern.description: One case-insensitive regex tested against each command segment; write alternation with |

extraDryRunPattern.title: Extra dry-run pattern
extraDryRunPattern.description: One case-insensitive regex for extra dry-run flags

disabledRules.title: Disabled rules
disabledRules.description: Comma-separated rule ids: sqlpackage, dotnet-ef, bcp, sqlcmd, migration-cli, data-script, sync-migrate-script, live-flag, custom

allowMinutes.title: Allowance minutes
allowMinutes.description: How long a granted allowance lasts

requireTypedAllow.title: Require typed allow
requireTypedAllow.description: Only a command you typed may run /guardrail allow

announce.title: Announce the policy to the model
announce.description: Add a short guardrail section to the system prompt
